output.analysis: Danny Ruiz is sending a new RFQ for stainless steel (316 SS) threaded fittings. The items requested are all in the body of the email: 10 of the 1/2" 90-degree fittings, 6 of the 1/2" tees, a couple (interpreted as quantity null as requested) 1/2" caps, 12 of the 3/4" couplings, and 20 of the 3/4" close nipples. No schedule or extra spec is mentioned beyond 316 SS threaded fittings. All lines come from the email body. There are no attachments, hidden, quoted, or struck content, so nothing to leave out. Delivery timeline is mentioned but not part of the line items.
